title: Trapping Rainwater
stepTitle: Stack and Queues [Learning, Pre-In-Post-fix, Monotonic Stack, Implementation]
intro: Stack = LIFO, Queue = FIFO. Use them when the next useful element is the most recent or the earliest pending.
intuition: Push when you defer work; pop when the deferred item becomes due.
pitfalls: Using stack where queue semantics needed.

cpp.notes: Monotonic stack/queue patterns adapt cleanly to “Trapping Rainwater”.
